newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan recovery slow, needs vigilance - Hashimoto.
newsitem.headline: Japan recovery slow, needs vigilance - Hashimoto.

text.p: The tempo of Japan's economic recovery remains gradual and still requires careful vigilance, Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Friday.

"Fortunately, the private sector is increasing in strength and the economy continues to recover. However, at the moment, the tempo is gradual and the jobs situation is still severe despite some improvement," Hashimoto said in a speech to a convention of life insurers.
"It is necessary to closely watch over the future direction of the economy," he added.

He said that an aging society and the globalisation of the world economy meant Japan must change its "overall system", pressing forward with structural reforms in the economy, administration and society.
In relation to the economy, Hashimoto cited the need for a more transparent financial system, better use of land and further deregulation.

On finance, he said authorities were working on collecting bad loans resulting from the collapse of seven housing loan companies. Financial institutions should work to dispose of their bad loans quickly, he added.
